column.text: Bitcoin is holding its ground near sixty-four thousand dollars while the broader tech sector crumbles under rising yields. Institutional money continues to flow into spot ETFs with a massive thirteen-seven million dollar inflow today, signaling serious accumulation ahead of the anticipated September Fed hold. Stablecoin dry powder sits at zero point twenty percent on SSR, ready to deploy if volatility spikes. Ethereum struggles in contrast showing bearish divergence as price drops three-quarters of one percent and RSI slides into oversold territory while open interest remains stubbornly stable. This pattern suggests a potential capitulation bottom forming before any genuine reversal can occur. The short-long ratio for BTC has finally inverted from prior extremes with longs now outnumbering shorts at one point four eight, indicating that the heavy bearish pressure is exhausting itself despite macro headwinds contracting dollar liquidity globally.
